title: FIELD_OPERATIONS_PLATFORM Root Pollution
rootCause: LOCAL_WORKSPACE_ROOT path resolution in runtime resolved 5 levels up to the IDE root instead of 3 levels up to projects/posting-map, resulting in app files being written directly to workspace root.
fix: Correct the relative path hierarchy to point directly to the project root directory.
lessonLearned: All application data must be isolated inside the application folder namespace. Always verify absolute path resolutions in tests before proceeding to deployment.
